title: EXPLORE-ON-GRAPH: INCENTIVIZING AUTONOMOUS EXPLORATION OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS ON KNOWLEDGE GRAPHS WITH PATH-REFINED REWARD MODELING
reasoning: The paper focuses on enhancing the reasoning and exploration capabilities of LLMs on Knowledge Graphs using reinforcement learning and path-refined reward modeling.
